purpose: Make a Campaign V3 steering residual discoverable and resumable by a cold agent from durable Git/runtime state alone, without requiring prior chat IDs or minting execution authority.

saga: append CAMPAIGN_V3_SOURCE_BOUND through campaign event-sourced mutation
source_binding.partial_failure: If Campaign.start succeeds but source binding fails, return STARTED_SOURCE_UNBOUND_HOLD with exact campaign/branch/start digest/checkpoint; never start a replacement blindly.

cold_discovery.inputs: shared runtime only; no campaign_id, branch_id, pulse_id or loop_id supplied
requirements: campaign checkpoint ancestor of current Git head
branch task equals source historical text
exactly one valid Campaign V3 candidate
cold_discovery.unbound_branch: DISCOVERED_SOURCE_BOUND_UNBOUND_BRANCH -> bind via integrated step-4 membrane
cold_discovery.bound_branch: delegate exact discovered campaign/branch/state/checkpoint to integrated fresh_resume_branch
cold_discovery.ambiguity: HOLD; never guess a campaign or branch identity
